  "CRITERIA_MATCH_EXPLANATION": "The paper discusses regional curriculum harmonization initiatives in Africa, specifically focusing on the East African Community (EAC) and the Southern African Development Community (SADC). It addresses harmonization across institutions and countries, mentioning regional frameworks, cross-border education, and mutual recognition of qualifications. For example, it mentions the EAC Protocol on Cooperation in Education, which aims to harmonize education systems and facilitate the mutual recognition of academic and professional qualifications (p. 535). It also discusses the SADC Protocol on Education and Training, which promotes regional cooperation in education and training (p. 536).",
